## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e823d8fd9d8ff2d24f4984bd381d81767035f990`
Local-runs: none
Scope: PR files read on head: `.changeset/30206-first-run-checklist.md`, `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/FirstRunChecklist.tsx` (whole), `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` (whole), `settingsFieldRefusals.ts` (whole), diffs of `SettingsField.tsx`, `SettingsView.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `AppContent.tsx`, `pages/auth/SetupPage.tsx`, `loadLocales.ts`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, `ui/e2e/live/global-setup.ts`, `examples/app-showcase/e2e/global-setup.ts`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`, the four console mock tests, the three i18n pin tests, and the `it(` rosters of the three new test files. Cited: `origin/main` `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx` (testids) and `en.ts` (removed block), `ui/packages/i18n/package.json`, `ui/packages/i18n/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts`, console settings `api.ts` and `types.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeLayout.tsx`, plugin-auth `ensure-default-organization.ts` and `default-organization-invariant.ts`, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (runtime-interface-only), `.changeset/config.json`, PR #29359's `.changeset/28789-i18n-retire-packaged-flows-keys.md` at `794e71cc`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, `ui/e2e/live/phone-nav-drawer-back-29131.spec.ts`, `AGENTS.md`, `ui/AGENTS.md`; hotcrm checkout.

### ① Derived judgments

- The 14 removed keys are exactly the `origin/main` `en.ts` block (`title, description, laterHint, decline, confirm, saved, currencyTitle, currencyDescription, currencyConfirm, currencySaved, bothTitle, bothConfirm, bothSaved, notNow`); all ten packs on head carry 0 `workspaceTimezonePrompt` and carry `firstRunChecklist` plus the three `invalidFormat*` keys.
- `git grep -n -i 'workspaceTimezonePrompt|WorkspaceTimezonePrompt|workspace-timezone-prompt' e823d8fd` hits only the changeset, CHANGELOG history and a doc comment in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/dev-admin-seed-workspace-timezone.test.ts:10` (prose; `packages/**` out of card scope, acknowledged). hotcrm: 0 hits. No import of `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` or `workspaceTimezonePromptLogic` survives (`SetupPage.tsx` now imports `browserTimeZone` from `firstRunChecklistLogic`). The dialog's testids appear nowhere in `ui/e2e`, `examples`, `docs`, `skills`, `content`.
- Writes without Confirm: none. The only server write is `saveSettingsNamespace(LOCALIZATION_NAMESPACE, changes)` in `SettingsRowEditor.onConfirm` (button `disabled={saving || !hasChanges}`); `onSaved` re-reads. Close writes `localStorage` only; Cancel is `setEditing(null)`; the mount effect chains reads only.
- Member path: `readChecklistSettings` returns `null` with no request when `systemPermissions` is absent or empty; otherwise one `GET /api/settings`, then `null` before any namespace read when `mayWrite` is false (fails closed on a missing `writePermission`). Members/invitations are read only after settings load. Pinned at `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx:244` and `:253`.
- DomainCombobox: `committedValue` order is exact value → exact label → `optionByName` → verbatim. `optionByName` strips only the option's own code from its label, compares trimmed and case-insensitive, and matches only when exactly one option carries the name; ambiguous or partial text stays verbatim and the server stays the judge. No `packages/**` file in the diff. `settingsFieldRefusals` re-words only `invalid_format` from `details.fields`.
- Entry exports: `ui/packages/i18n` `exports` and `src/index.ts` untouched; `TranslationKeys = typeof en` loses members only. `@object-ui/react` re-exports `type TranslationKeys` (see ③). `ui/apps/console` is an app.
- Mount: `App.tsx` `HomeRoute` renders `FirstRunChecklist` inside `DefaultHomeLayout` on `/home`, under `ConsolePermissionsScope`; `AppContent.tsx` drops the dialog's mount and import.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n` (both in the Changesets `fixed` group), with `feat(console)!:` and `**BREAKING**` as carriers, as PR #29359. `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` level axis: `Metadata-protocol: none`, every entry `patch`, no authorable baseline moves → clean. `Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — …` matches `clause2-line.mjs`. ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys)` resolves to an exported `type` in a non-zod, non-contracts file, not a `z.infer` projection; `git grep '\bTranslationKeys\b' -- '*.zod.ts' 'packages/spec/src/contracts/**'` is empty.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:3687`: a live QA step still tells runners to dismiss the retired currency prompt with "Not now" (RUNNER.md was corrected, this area file was not). Docs-only follow-up.
- `DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_NAME` duplicates plugin-auth's literal with no test holding them equal; a server-side rename would make row 1 read "named". Acknowledged in the PR and code.
- The `TranslationKeys` narrowing also transits `@object-ui/react`'s type re-export; lockstep versioning makes the bump identical; same as #29359. Cosmetic.
- An `isDefault` landing app sends the administrator past Home at sign-in. Acknowledged.
- Dismissal is per-device `localStorage`; dismissing also silences the mail and invite rows.
- Every undismissed administrator Home mount issues up to five reads, since "draws nothing when done" is decided after the reads.
- Both e2e global-setups lose the decline step; the only live spec visiting `/home` asserts drawer visibility and URLs, unaffected.
- PR body's `de-quote-pairing-3876` count read 104 → 106; the diff moves 105 → 107 (body corrected by the seat). Live before/after readings were taken on #30552's head `9914c31f`.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing removes only keys the retired dialog read: the head tree and hotcrm hold no reader of `console.workspaceTimezonePrompt.*`, no import of the removed modules and no use of its testids. The one published surface narrowed is the `TranslationKeys` type; `t()` keys are `string`, so a stale caller still compiles and echoes its key. No declared capability leaves a consumer; the new keys, the Home checklist and the `invalid_format` wording are widenings. Consistent with #29359.
